items.source: Build a ServerHttpRequest decorator with the mutated properties.
items.translation: 构建一个带有变异属性的 `ServerHttpRequest` 装饰器。

items.source: The given value must be a valid contextPath and it must match the start of the path of the URI of the request. That means changing the contextPath, implies also changing the path via path(String).
items.translation: 给定值必须是有效的contextPath，并且必须匹配请求 URI 路径的开头。这意味着更改 contextPath 也意味着需要通过 path(String) 更改路径。

items.source: If you need to add header values, remove headers, etc., use headers(Consumer) for greater control.
items.translation: 如果需要添加标头值、移除标头等，请使用 headers(Consumer) 以获得更大的控制能力。

items.source:
Set the path to use instead of the "rawPath" of the URI of the request with the following conditions:
  • If uri is also set, the path given here overrides the path of the given URI.
  • If contextPath is also set, or already present, it must match the start of the path given here.
  • The given value must begin with a slash.
items.translation:
设置路径以替代请求 URI 的 "rawPath"，需满足以下条件：
  • 如果也设置了 uri，此处给出的路径将覆盖给定 URI 的路径。
  • 如果也设置了 contextPath 或已存在，它必须与此处给出的路径开头匹配。
  • 给定值必须以斜杠开头。

items.source:
Set the URI to use with the following conditions:
  • If path is also set, it overrides the path of the URI provided here.
  • If contextPath is also set, or already present, it must match the start of the path of the URI provided here.
items.translation:
设置要使用的 URI，条件如下：
  • 如果同时设置了 path，它将覆盖此处提供的 URI 的路径。
  • 如果同时设置了 contextPath，或者它已经存在，则必须与此处提供的 URI 路径的开头匹配。

items.source: Manipulate request headers. The provided HttpHeaders contains current request headers, so that the Consumer can overwrite or remove existing values, or use any other HttpHeaders methods.
items.translation: 操纵请求标头。提供的 `HttpHeaders` 包含当前请求标头，以便 `Consumer` 可以覆盖或移除现有值，或使用任何其他 HttpHeaders 方法。

items.source: Set the path to use instead of the "rawPath" of the URI of the request with the following conditions: If uri is also set, the path given here overrides the path of the given URI.
items.translation: 设置路径以替代请求 URI 的 `"rawPath"`，条件如下： 如果也设置了 uri，则此处给出的路径将覆盖给定 URI 的路径。

items.source: Set the URI to use with the following conditions: If path is also set, it overrides the path of the URI provided here.
items.translation: 设置要使用的 URI，条件如下： 如果也设置了path，它将覆盖此处提供的 URI 的路径。

items.source: Set the address of the local client.
items.translation: 设置本地客户端的地址。

items.source: Set the HTTP method to return.
items.translation: 将 HTTP 方法设置为要返回的方法。

items.source: Set the address of the remote client.
items.translation: 设置远程客户端的地址。

items.source:
Set the SSL session information. This may be useful in environments
where TLS termination is done at the router, but SSL information is
made available in some other way such as through a header.
items.translation: 设置 SSL 会话信息。这在路由器上执行 TLS 终止，但通过其他方式（例如通过标头）提供 SSL 信息的环境中可能很有用。

items.source: headerValues - the header values
items.translation: headerValues - 标头值

items.source: Builder for mutating an existing ServerHttpRequest.
items.translation: 用于修改现有ServerHttpRequest的构建器。

items.source: Set the contextPath to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的 contextPath。

items.source: Set or override the specified header values under the given name.
items.translation: 在指定名称下设置或覆盖指定的标头值。

items.source: Manipulate request headers.
items.translation: 操纵请求头。

items.source: Set the SSL session information.
items.translation: 设置 SSL 会话信息。

items.source: headerName - the header name
items.translation: headerName - 标头名称
